meanings.name: sys_scene_setup_done
meanings.summary: The scene's palette buffer, PPU registers and HDMA tables are set up: ClearSceneState clears the flag before it rebuilds the scene, the scene-start sequence sets it after its two thinker passes, and the inventory overlay clears it at open and sets it after the first render frame of its close path. Thinkers that own palette or HDMA state re-apply it in every pass that finds the flag clear.

effects.set: The HDMA and PPU-register thinkers (sine_hdma_slow_wave, sine_hdma_ending_wave, sine_hdma_dual_channel, native_village_sine_hdma, dao_sine_hdma_slow, larai_cliff_scroll_wave, palace_coffin_hdma_table, mu_tint_and_wave, comet_lair_hdma_a/b/c_timed, sE8_comet_display_config) continue their per-frame tick; palace_fountain_palette keeps cycling; the palette loops that wait for a clear flag (edward_castle_alarm_palette, dream_palette_loop, flag_gated_palette_cool/warm, gold_ship_wreck_palette) stay parked.
effects.clear: The HDMA and PPU-register thinkers jump back to their init label and rewrite their tables or registers; palace_fountain_palette sets the flag again and rewrites CGADSUB; the parked palette loops resume, replay their bundle and set the flag again.

evidence: extracted/system/engine/scene_lifecycle.asm:844 {253423} (write that clears bit 7: the direct clear at the top of ClearSceneState)
extracted/system/inventory/inventory_overlay.asm:133 {191819} (write that clears bit 7: the direct clear at open)
meanings.notes: One flag with one meaning, not an idiom. The protocol: (1) only the engine clears it, at two sites that are direct writes, not COP clears (the inventory has 0 ClearFlagByte/ClearFlagWord sites with operand $FF, and its direct_accesses list writes of $0A00-$0A3F only at those two places, besides the flag helpers, which take a computed index, and save_system, which copies the whole array; ClearEventFlag is called only by the COP handlers, ClearFlagRaw only by ir1F_gold_tile with indices 1-4); (2) the engine sets it at {253564} (scene setup) and {192190} (overlay close); (3) thinkers that own state which the rebuild destroys test it: pattern A (12 placed thinker files and the unplaced native_village_dup_unused: init, SetEntryHereAndYield, branch back to init while the flag is clear) re-initialises HDMA tables or PPU registers; pattern B (5 placed palette loops and the unplaced palette_buffer_clear_unused: set the flag themselves, then WaitOnFlagByte(FF, clear)) replay their palette bundle; palace_fountain_palette is a hybrid (it sets the flag, cycles, and sets it again when it finds it clear). Pattern B cannot be woken by a scene setup: the scene's thinker list is built by SpawnSceneThinkers after the clear at {253418}, and the scene-start passes at {253549}/{253553} come before the set at {253564}. It wakes once per inventory close: RestoreGameState restores the saved thinker list, ResetThinkerWaitCounters (inventory_overlay.asm:295, called at {192179}) zeroes the wait counters, and the first UpdateFrameRender at {192186} runs RunThinkers_Hdma_Light and RunThinkers_General_Light while $FF is still clear (the overlay's eventFlags restore at {192094} covers flags $00-$0F only); the set at {192190} comes after that frame. The shipped thinker notes say 'next scene setup or inventory open': the first half is wrong, the second is the close path (specs/FL31_notes.json). Self-sets by thinkers (12 sites: 2 engine and 10 in thinker files, 9 of them placed) cannot hide a clear from a later thinker of the same pass: the only scenes in which one file sets and another file tests are $5C (palace_coffin_hdma_table sets, sine_hdma_dual_channel tests; thinker_spawn_0CE96F lists the coffin thinker first) and $E8 (testers only). The coffin thinker sets the flag one tick after its init (SetFlagByte at {48753} follows SetEntryHereAndYield), so in the pass that finds the flag clear it re-initialises without setting, and the engine's own set at {192190} (or {253564} at scene setup) comes before its next tick. Two thinkers in unused/ (native_village_dup_unused, palette_buffer_clear_unused) are referenced by no scene thinker list.
